title: Knotty by Nature | KEY.co
description_expanded: Step inside to an open floor plan that seamlessly combines the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The living space is adorned with new designer furnishings, including a spacious sectional sofa and a top-of-the-line Samsung 4K Smart TV with a Sonos soundbar. Directly across is the newly renovated chef's kitchen, featuring a marble center island with bar seating for three. Thoughtfully designed for cooking and family meals, the kitchen boasts a built-in Sub Zero panel large refrigerator, a Wolf range four-burner gas stove with a griddle, and a Bosch dishwasher. The nearby dining table, overlooking the screened-in porch, comfortably accommodates eight guests, while a cozy reading nook provides a serene spot to unwind. Discover the ultimate seaside retreat with this premier vacation home featuring a pool. Recently renovated in the Spring of 2021, this stunning one-story house boasts brand-new furnishings, a modern gourmet kitchen, and upgraded bathrooms. Whether you're entertaining guests or savoring a morning breakfast or evening wine, the large L-shaped wrap-around porch offers a picturesque setting. Complete with outdoor lounge seating, a Smart TV, and additional dining space, this home is perfect for embracing outdoor living. Additionally, an ice maker is available for convenient beach outings and entertaining.
